services.name: Lessons & Programs
services.desc: You will receive 50% of your fees back if you cancel 7 or more days before your program begins. If you cancel within 7 days of your clinic there is no refund. Program Description: Pre-program players are required to have the ability to start a rally with a serve and maintain it for six shots from the service line. Focus includes shot direction and learning to play points with basic tactics. Players develop a strong first serve and a basic second serve. The goal is to rally consistently from the baseline by the end of the session. Program Description: Players start on smaller courts with mini nets, focusing on proprioception and coordination. services.desc: Registration will be online only for 2026. Each child and each week will have to be registered for separately. All camps are scheduled on Monday to Thursday (except for long weekends). Please ensure your child is sent with a tennis racquet, hat, sunscreen, snack, and water bottle. We will provide tennis balls. You will receive a 90% refund if you cancel one month or longer before your child's camp begins. If you cancel between 7 days and one month of your child's camp, you will receive a 50% refund.
